messages:
Asha V.: Heads-up: customer asks for smoother bursts without restarting autoscaler. Proposal: token-bucket burst smoothing + ML predictive autoscale pilot. Thoughts?
Connor B.: Token-bucket for tenant bursts makes sense. simple leaky-bucket: allow short spikes, smooth over 60s. need to pick bucket size semantics (absolute tokens vs pct of commit).
Maya P.: Prefer pct-of-commit for predictability. e.g., bucket=20% of commit, refill rate=commit/60s. keeps larger tenants proportional.
Riley (oncall): Ops caveat: we must emit a new metric 'burst_smoothing_state' with values {normal, throttled, spilled} and an alert when spilled_count > 5/min for any tenant.
Asha V.: Good. For predictive autoscale: ML model predicts 5min ahead using request rate + time-of-day + calendar signals. If predicted_load > capacity*0.95, autoscaler preemptively scale or prewarm.
Connor B.: ML model addition is medium effort. MVP: heuristic predictive rules (EWMA + peak-detection) first, ML later. keeps rollout simpler.
Maya P.: Agree. Pilot plan: phase1=token-bucket + telemetry + heuristic predictor. phase2=ML predictor + regional prewarm.
BillingBot: Note: smoothing changes may affect revenue reporting. propose: spilled_tokens logged as "smoothed_spill" and billed normally unless involuntary eviction occurs.
Legal - Priya: If billing unchanged, surface in contract: "smoothing is behavior management; only involuntary drops are eligible for credits." Put opt-out language for customers who want no throttling.
Asha V.: Launch criteria draft: 1) token-bucket implemented + config per-tenant 2) burst_smoothing_state telemetry + dashboard 3) heuristic predictor enabled behind feature-flag 4) billing tags for smoothed vs spilled 5) pilot with 3 tenants and opt-out option documented.
Connor B.: Implementation notes: autoscaler needs a smoothing layer before admission controller. I'll sketch PR with pseudocode this week. sample: ```bucket = min(max_bucket, commit * 0.2); if token_request <= tokens: allow else mark throttled```
Riley (oncall): Runbook: when spilled_count > threshold, page SRE and open a throttling investigation ticket. include steps to toggle smoothing FF and revert predictor.
Maya P.: Timeline: token-bucket + telemetry in 2 sprints, heuristic predictor + dashboard in sprint 3, pilot in sprint 4. If leadership OK, I'll add to roadmap.
Asha V.: Action items: @Connor draft PR for smoothing layer, @Maya own predictor FF + dashboard, @Riley update runbook, @Priya draft contract blurb. I'll coordinate pilot invites. If no objections by EOD Fri, I'll file the PRs. :rocket:
